method.effective_potential_update: Full effective potential from the current density; no delta-DM update.
method.model_scope: Native direct electron repulsion integrals; no density fitting.

identity.scope: Source-relative geometric preservation, not independent chemical identity validation.

settings.effective_potential_update: Full effective potential from the current density; no delta-DM update.
settings.model_scope: Native direct electron repulsion integrals; no density fitting.

electronic_stability.external_native_return_status_scope: PySCF2.13 rhf_external return_status reports RKS-to-UKS only; real-to-complex is explicitly parsed from native solver eigenvalue log.
electronic_stability.scope: Actual RKS internal orbital repair plus RKS-to-UKS and real-to-complex tests; external or unknown/failed tests are not passes.

analysis.mass_source: pyscf.data.elements.MASSES standard isotope-average masses; explicit matching fallback for common elements

constants.IR_convention: standard integrated km/mol, no ln(10), unbroadened

step_comparison.interpretation: Empirical finite-step sensitivity, not a rigorous error bound; individual vectors/IR intensities in degenerate subspaces are basis-dependent.

qualification.scope: Local isolated-molecule harmonic calculation at the stated method; no global-conformer minimum or solid-state chemical peak assignment is established.

notes: All signed vibrational modes are retained; negative eigenvalues are imaginary modes, never replaced by absolute frequencies.
Dipole-derivative projections on imaginary directions are diagnostic values, not absorption transitions of a stable minimum.
Raw antisymmetry is measured before averaging H with H.T for a real symmetric vibrational problem.
Cartesian display vectors have Euclidean unit norm; mass-normalized Cartesian vectors, not display vectors, enter IR contraction.
Finite-step disagreement is empirical evidence of numerical sensitivity, not a rigorous bound on all numerical or model errors.
Positive projected modes do not replace an independently checked fresh nuclear gradient or electronic orbital-stability test.
Gas-phase molecular IR intensities and frequencies do not establish drug-solid THz peak identities.

step_comparisons.interpretation: Empirical step sensitivity, not a rigorous error bound or a grid/basis convergence proof.

direct-grid5.scope: Isolated-molecule local harmonic/IR result at the explicitly recorded numerical model.
